title: Factory event envelope, v2
description: The fields every factory event line carries, whatever its state (docs/events.md), written since 2026-10-11 (#316). callum-flow-event writes every key on every line, null when it has no value; a key is never omitted (data is the one exception: present only when the state has a payload). Frozen: a change to the envelope is a new envelope version in a new file.

ts.description: When the event was written, UTC, to the second.

repo.description: The repo the event is about, owner/name (--repo, CALLUM_FLOW_REPO, else the origin remote; the directory name when there is no remote).

device.description: The machine that wrote the event: DEV_MACHINE_NAME, else the hostname.

session_id.description: The Claude session that wrote the event: CLAUDE_SESSION_ID, else the newest transcript of the working directory's Claude project; null when neither is known.

actor.description: Who wrote it: --actor, CALLUM_FLOW_ACTOR, else "agent". Free text; the values in use are listed in docs/events.md.

state.description: What happened: one word from the closed vocabulary. Each state has its own schema in states/.

issue.description: The GitHub issue the event is about (--issue, or the issue-<N> part of --branch).

run_id.description: The no-mistakes pipeline run (--run). Usually a ULID; "unknown" when a watcher could not tell.

head.description: A commit sha (--head): the run's or the PR's head, as the state defines.

note.description: A short line for people (--note). Some older states put machine-read fields here; each state's schema says when, and new events put fields in data instead.

event_id.description: A UUID made locally when the line was written, unique per event even if the log file is lost; null when the kernel's UUID source was unreadable.

base_image.description: The running base image version (dev-version --json), null when unknown.

dev_image.description: The running dev image version, null when unknown.

template_version.description: The running Coder template version, null when unknown.

plugin_version.description: The running callum-flow plugin version, null when unknown.

data.description: The event's structured payload, when its state defines one: a JSON object naming its own schema and version (docs/events.md, 'Payloads'). Absent on every event written today. Each state's schema says which payloads it accepts.

payloadHeader.description: What every payload carries: the name of its schema (schemas/events/data/<schema>/) and that schema's version (v<version>.schema.json there).
